period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary half-yearly interim financial statements ("Financial Statements for the Half Yearly ended 30 June 2015 (Unaudited)"), used as the Q2 data point. This copy is a high-quality scanned image (no embedded text layer) rather than a native-text PDF; figures were read visually from a high-resolution page render. Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 30 June 2015 (Unaudited)' / 'Profit and Loss Account for the half year ended 30 June 2015 (Unaudited)') figures are used, not 'Consolidated'. Total equity is cross-validated via the (unlabelled, i.e. Solo) Statement of Changes in Equity's closing balance (23,570,395,192), which is clearer in the scan than the Balance Sheet's own 'Total liabilities' line; Total liabilities is therefore derived as Total assets minus this cross-validated equity figure rather than read directly. All P&L subtotals from Total operating income (6,067.05m) down to Net profit after tax (1,447.62m) reconcile exactly. Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported). NAV per share is not disclosed in this primary interim statement and is left out as a genuine gap.

source.source_page_lines: Single-page landscape layout (4 columns), scanned image with no text layer; read visually via high-resolution page render (pdftoppm -r 200)
